name: @gjsify/integration-effect
description: Integration tests: Effect 4 on GJS and Node. Effect's fiber runtime is the hardest scheduling consumer we have — it drives every microtask, timer, AbortSignal and finalizer we implement — and Effect 4 folds FileSystem/Path/Stream/Schema into one package, so a single dependency exercises @gjsify/{timers,process,fs,path,abort-controller,stream} through a real consumer's own test suite.

scripts.build:test:gjs: gjsify build src/test.gjs.mts --app gjs --globals auto --outfile dist/test.gjs.mjs
scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:node && gjsify run build:test:gjs
scripts.test: gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs

author: Pascal Garber <pascal@artandcode.studio>
